notes: Six static fixture cases cover all four renderer families: ready explanation, active diagnostic and artifact forms, completed reflection, safe fallback, and stale evidence recovery. This samples 4 of 7 kinds and 5 of 9 states in 36 captures rather than the full 378-case matrix. Worked examples, source comparison, and independent application share ReadySessionCanvas; blocked/preparing/invalidated overlap the sampled recovery layouts. Offline requires a network transition rather than just the harness query state. These are synthetic projections, not persisted learner outcomes. Fill separation guards against regression from the current frame; it is not a claim about design quality.
